results.title: Will Brady Tkachuk Fold Under the Immense Pressure the Panthers Just Placed on Him?
results.description: Ottawa had real questions about Brady Tkachuk‘s leadership qualities. A useful player on the ice who never shied away from standing up for his teammates or playing an aggressive style, he often ran into issues off the ice, where he was criticized for not handling speculation about his future well and for focusing too much on building his brand.
